articles.title: Red Sox’ Payton Tolle accomplishes ‘big goal’ on off day as rookie dives into charitable efforts
articles.description: Even in the middle of a rookie season that interim manager Chad Tracy recently described as “amazing,” Red Sox starter Payton Tolle is finding ways to spend some time giving back to the community.

articles.title: Red Sox win includes Willson Contreras making sure fans don’t boo
articles.description: Willson Contreras, who missed 12 games with a left hamstring strain, helped the Red Sox to a 4-1 victory over the Royals at Fenway Park.

articles.title: Red Sox’ Payton Tolle, ‘an electric human being,’ smiles during immaculate inning
articles.description: Rookie Payton Tolle looked into the Red Sox dugout and smiled before throwing the final pitch that completed his immaculate inning Sunday.

articles.title: Red Sox reactions: Fired-up Payton Tolle dominates in win
articles.description: Instant reactions from the Red Sox’ 4-1 win over the Royals on Sunday at Fenway Park:

articles.title: Payton Tolle throws eighth immaculate inning in Red Sox team history
articles.description: Red Sox starting pitcher Payton Tolle rewarded the fans who waited out a one-hour, 50-minute rain delay.

articles.title: Returning Red Sox pitcher will embrace ‘Swiss Army Knife’ role
articles.description: Tanner Houck will pitch in two more rehab games for Triple-A Worcester on Tuesday and Saturday before potentially rejoining the Red Sox during the final week of the regular season.

articles.title: Red Sox’ Chad Tracy receives daily salute from rookie (notebook)
articles.description: Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy received his daily greeting Sunday morning from his rookie starting pitcher.

articles.title: Red Sox game vs. Royals delayed due to rain; team expects to play Sunday
articles.description: The start of the Red Sox-Royals game on Sunday has been delayed due to rain.

articles.title: Red Sox roster moves: Willson Contreras activated, infielder to IL (lineup)
articles.description: The Red Sox reinstated first baseman Willson Contreras from the 10-day injured list on Sunday.

Red Sox win includes ‘brilliant’ start by All-Star, ‘wait-and-see’ injury to infielder (notebook)
articles.description: During an eight-start stretch that culminated with a stinker at Yankee Stadium on August 30, Ranger Suarez looked little like the pitcher who earned an All-Star nod in the first half of his first season with the Red Sox. In his last two outings, however, the lefty has righted the ship.

articles.title: The Red Sox ‘were waiting’ — and Wilyer Abreu delivered
articles.description: The Red Sox finally received a big, two-out, go-ahead swing Saturday from Wilyer Abreu in a 5-1 win over the Royals at Fenway Park.

articles.title: Red Sox change start time of Sunday’s game vs. Royals
articles.description: With rain in the forecast Sunday, the Red Sox announced a new start time for their series finale against the Royals.

articles.title: Red Sox reactions: Ranger Suarez dominates, Wilyer Abreu has big swing in win over Royals
articles.description: The Red Sox snapped a three-game losing streak with a tidy win over the Royals on Saturday afternoon. Ranger Suarez (seven innings) and Wilyer Abreu (two-run double) led the way.

articles.title: After lost season, could big righty from winter trade give the Red Sox ‘another arm’ in October?
articles.description: It has been a lost season for Red Sox righty Johan Oviedo, who has pitched just once all year. Now that he's back in Boston, could he potentially help the club in October?

articles.title: Is Red Sox’ Roman Anthony trying to ‘overcook it?’ (notebook)
articles.description: Red Sox' Chad Tracy said about Roman Anthony: "He probably got into some spots where he’s starting to like overdo it, overcook it a little bit.”
